main_body: A vending machine, drawn as a tall magenta cabinet. A grey-blue header with a dark slot sits on top, then a pink band, then a front face with a window of shelves and a side button column.
top_band: Grey-blue block at rows 1-5 with a dark slot. It reads as a vertical header panel with a slot, not a horizontal surface. A pink 1-2 row band sits at rows 6-7. No distinct lighter top surface.
evidence: Down the middle column, the grey header (rows 1-5) is a face-on panel with a slot, then a 1-2px pink line (rows 6-7), then the magenta front face. The pink line is a rim, not a surface. The window, shelves and buttons are painted face-on with at most a thin dark edge, so there is no real inset. No horizontal surface is visible from above, which matches the front elevation example in the guide.

style.evidence: The magenta body uses about 3-4 tones and the header about 3. The outline is a dark purple that leans toward the body colour, so it is not black. There are large flat fills: the body panels, the lower dark panel and the header. There is almost no grain or speckle, and the tiles carry few colours (about 3-5) against the references' per-tile richness in the stall and well, so it is thinner and flatter than the references.
